_what: The board re-ranked as if FantasyPros were the only projection source. vorp and tier recomputed by the SAME functions build.py uses, never a second implementation.
_cannot: A player this source does not project is ABSENT, not bad. Never read a short list as a verdict.

draftable_scope._focus_vs_outer: focus (200) is the working scope: 150 drafted plus 50 of headroom for runs, injuries and reaches. outer (250) is the widest Cory named and is the right scope for a question that must not clip the tail. Neither is a tuned constant -- both are Cory's ruling, quoted above, and drafted is derived.
draftable_scope._why_not_all_700: The board carries 700 players because the ingest carries 700. Only 150 get drafted. Reporting anything -- coverage, accuracy, agreement -- over all 700 measures the deep bench nobody takes, and it makes real sources look broken: Draft Sharks covers 35% of 700 and 94% of the top 200. The first number is true and useless, the second is the one that decides a pick.
